suggestions.reason: Trivially satisfiable — any number above 2.0 passes even if the body was untouched. It only discriminates when paired with the content assertions; consider folding it into assertion 3 and freeing a slot for a content check.

The fixture plants four verification traps that no assertion covers: v2.0 claims 2026-07-24_001_tokens-handoff.md was incorporated (file absent), records commit 7c21ab4 (HEAD is a3549a9, single commit), asserts signup is complete pointing at src/auth/signup.ts (absent), and reports 'Test status: passing' (no tests, vitest not installed). This run caught all four; a weaker run would copy them forward as current fact and still pass all 14 assertions. Add something like: 'v2.0's unverifiable technical state (commit 7c21ab4, build/test passing, the 2026-07-24 handoff as incorporated) is not restated as verified current fact.' That is the single most discriminating check available in this fixture.

Assertions 11-13 sample only three v2.0 items for preservation. A run that regenerated the master from the two Dailies alone would still pass them while losing the jose/jsonwebtoken final decision, the session TTL open decision, the SCSS->tokens superseded row, the API rate-limit risk, and the 2026-07-22 handoff row. Consider one assertion requiring that every v2.0 Final/Open decision and every existing Superseded-table row survives.

suggestions.assertion: The localStorage session-storage decision is no longer presented as a current Final/locked decision
suggestions.reason: As written, wholesale deletion of the localStorage decision also passes — which is the failure mode assertion 6 exists to catch. Tightening this to 'retained and marked superseded, not deleted' would make the pair non-redundant and each individually discriminating.

Nothing checks that the update did not fabricate. This run's numbers all held up under direct file inspection, but the assertion set would not catch an invented commit hash, an invented ticket ID, or invented cookie attributes. An assertion that repo-derived facts (HEAD, dependency versions, cookie attribute values, tracked-file list) match the actual project would guard the highest-risk failure for this skill.

eval_feedback.overall: Strong, specific assertion set that covers the core cumulative-update behaviours (in-place update, supersession without loss, conflict recording, staleness repair). The gap is verification: the fixture deliberately seeds four false inherited claims and nothing asserts they were caught, so a run that faithfully copies stale facts forward would score 14/14. Add one anti-stale-inheritance assertion and one broad v2.0-preservation assertion.
